standardSupportPolicy.note: Managed Service for Apache Spark (formerly Dataproc) publishes per-image-version "Supported until" and "Available until" dates rather than separate Standard/Basic support tiers. After the supported-until date the image version is no longer recommended for new clusters; after the available-until date it can no longer be selected at all.

applicationDescriptions.Apache Atlas: Apache Atlas, a data governance and metadata management framework for cataloging and classifying data assets.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Flink: Apache Flink, a distributed engine for stateful stream and batch data processing.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Hadoop: Apache Hadoop, the core distributed storage (HDFS) and resource management (YARN) framework underlying most Spark cluster workloads.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Hive: Apache Hive, a data warehouse system providing SQL-like querying over large datasets stored in HDFS or Cloud Storage.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Hive WebHCat: A REST API for Hive's metastore, letting external tools submit Hive/Pig/MapReduce jobs and access table metadata over HTTP.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Hudi: Apache Hudi, a transactional data lake framework enabling upserts, deletes, and incremental data processing.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Iceberg: Apache Iceberg, a high-performance open table format for large analytic datasets with schema evolution and snapshot isolation.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka, a distributed event streaming platform for building real-time data pipelines and messaging systems.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Pig: Apache Pig, a high-level scripting platform for expressing data transformations as dataflows over Hadoop.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Spark: Apache Spark, a unified analytics engine for large-scale batch processing, streaming, SQL, and machine learning.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Sqoop: Apache Sqoop, a tool for transferring bulk data between Hadoop and relational databases.
applicationDescriptions.Apache Tez: Apache Tez, a data processing framework that provides a faster execution engine underneath Hive and Pig.
applicationDescriptions.BigQuery Connector: The Spark BigQuery connector, enabling Spark jobs to read from and write to Google BigQuery tables directly.
applicationDescriptions.Cloud Storage Connector: The Hadoop Cloud Storage connector, letting Hadoop and Spark treat Google Cloud Storage buckets as a distributed filesystem.
applicationDescriptions.Conscrypt: Conscrypt, a Java security provider using BoringSSL for faster, more up-to-date TLS and cryptography support on the JVM.
applicationDescriptions.Delta Lake: Delta Lake, an open table format that adds ACID transactions and versioning to Spark-based data lakes.
applicationDescriptions.Docker: Docker, a container runtime used to package and run custom or optional-component workloads on the cluster.
applicationDescriptions.Hue: A web-based interface for browsing HDFS, running Hive queries, and managing workflows.
applicationDescriptions.Java: The Java runtime (JDK) that Spark, Hadoop, and other JVM-based cluster components run on.
applicationDescriptions.JupyterLab Notebook: JupyterLab, a web-based interactive notebook interface for exploratory data analysis and Spark job development.
applicationDescriptions.Oozie: Apache Oozie, a workflow scheduler for coordinating and managing Hadoop jobs.
applicationDescriptions.Python: The Python runtime and package manager (Conda/Mamba/Pixi, version-dependent) available for PySpark and general scripting.
applicationDescriptions.R: The R runtime, available for statistical computing and SparkR/sparklyr workloads.
applicationDescriptions.Ranger: Apache Ranger, a centralized framework for managing data security, authorization, and auditing across the cluster.
applicationDescriptions.Scala: The Scala runtime used to compile and run Spark and other JVM-based big data applications.
applicationDescriptions.Solr: Apache Solr, a search platform providing full-text search and indexing over data stored on the cluster.
applicationDescriptions.Trino: Trino, a distributed SQL query engine for fast interactive analytics across heterogeneous data sources.
applicationDescriptions.Zeppelin Notebook: Apache Zeppelin, a web-based notebook for interactive data exploration, visualization, and collaboration.
applicationDescriptions.Zookeeper: Apache ZooKeeper, a distributed coordination service used for configuration, naming, and synchronization across cluster services.

2.2.additionalNotes: Image version 2.2 becomes the default image version on September, 13, 2024.

notes.componentVersionSource: Application/component versions are taken from the latest sub-minor patch listed on each release's own version-detail page (e.g. image-release-2.3) at fetch time, not from the summary table on the main versioning page. Sub-minor patches within the same release line usually share identical component versions.
notes.osVariants: Each release ships as three OS variants (Debian, Ubuntu LTS, Rocky Linux) with the same component/date info; only the OS image name suffix differs. See releaseInfo.<release>.osImages for the exact image names.
notes.version30Preview: Release 3.0 is a Preview release as of this writing; its component versions and dates may still change before general availability.
